name: Crocodile Breathing

instructions.description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on stacked hands.
Allow the legs to relax and let the body settle into the floor.
Inhale through the nose and feel the abdomen and lower ribs expand gently into the floor.
Exhale slowly and notice the body soften before the next breath.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a slow easy breathing rhythm.
Focus on posterior and lateral rib expansion.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Practice slow rib-cage expansion in a folded kneeling position.

commentsNotes: Turn the head only if needed for comfort.
Avoid holding the breath between cycles.
